title: Grade Calculator
description: Write a Zig program that takes a score (integer 0-100) and prints the corresponding letter grade: A (90+), B (80-89), C (70-79), D (60-69), F (below 60).
hints: Zig allows `if`/`else if`/`else` as expressions that return values
Use `{c}` format specifier to print a character
Use `const` for the grade variable since it's assigned once by the `if` expression
